correctness.rationale: For the 25 points A=(Z/5)² with circular L1 grid distance and inclusive VR threshold3, barycentric fixed points under a line L correspond to admissible five-point L-orbits, orbit unions forming VR faces. Horizontal/vertical quotient has five orbit vertices joined cyclically => S1. Slope±1 orbit contains a distance4 pair => empty. For slopes±2, each five-point orbit has diameter≤3 but any union of distinct orbits contains a distance4 pair => exactly five isolated barycenters. A-transitivity gives empty full A fixed space. The subgroup lattice is exactly {0}, six lines and A. The established Adams et al Theorem7.1 supplies only ordinary H~4=Q^9. Lefschetz for all nonidentity translations yields traces -1 for circle/empty, +4 for five points; at identity9. The characters match Q⊕V_2⊕V_3 since each V_s has trace4 on L_s, -1 off it. Over semisimple Q[A] characters determine the module. Independent direct orbit-metric calculation returned quotient f-vectors (5 vertices,5 edges) slopes0/∞, zero slopes1/4, five isolated vertices slopes2/3. Source verifier was read and includes exhaustive 25,531-face Morse and signed-chain certificates, but its logs were not used as proof of the fixed orbit argument.
